_comment: 🧩️ The tiled-map module's contribution to the repository test platform. `mercantile` is the published reference implementation of the EPSG:3857 Web-Mercator projection and the OSM/Mapbox XYZ slippy-tile scheme this module's `projection`/`tiles` implement, so it belongs to this owner rather than to the test framework.

oracles.rationale: Pure-Python, zero-runtime-dependency reference implementation of the published EPSG:3857 Web-Mercator forward/inverse formulas and the OSM/Mapbox XYZ slippy-tile numbering scheme — the same published specification `projection::lonlat_to_world`/`world_to_lonlat` and `tiles::visible_tiles` implement. `🧪️tests/web-mercator-tile-oracle/🐍️.py` re-derives every vector in the case-local `local://🔣️.json` fixture from `mercantile` directly and asserts agreement with the frozen fixture; the sibling `tests/🗺️tiled_map_mercator_oracle.rs` Rust integration test reads the SAME frozen fixture and asserts this module's own implementation agrees with it, so oracle and subject are checked against identical inputs. `lodBands` in that fixture are NOT covered by this oracle — `GIS_MAP_LOD_MAX_SPAN_DEG`/`GIS_MAP_LOD_TILE_Z` are a repository-owned band scheme with no published external standard.
